name: Direforge Hill
summary: Direforge Hill is a rugged highland in the northeastern Wetlands, southeast of Dun Modr and northeast of the Green Belt. The Dark Iron dwarf warlock Balgaras the Foul commands a hostile encampment on its slopes.

sections.title: A Bastion of Dark Sorcery
sections.body: Direforge Hill serves as a major Dark Iron campsite in the northeastern Wetlands. Balgaras the Foul, a Dark Iron dwarf warlock, commands the hostile dwarves occupying the hill southeast of Dun Modr.

sections.title: The Threat to the Wetlands
sections.body: The Dark Iron dwarves occupying Direforge Hill pose a threat to travelers through the northeastern Wetlands. Balgaras the Foul commands the hostile encampment.

faq.answer: Direforge Hill is located in the northeastern portion of the Wetlands. It lies southeast of Dun Modr, just northeast of the lush Green Belt, and northwest of the rocky bluffs of Raptor Ridge.

faq.q: Who controls Direforge Hill right now?
faq.answer: The hill is occupied by hostile Dark Iron dwarves commanded by the warlock Balgaras the Foul. They have fortified the high ground with barricades, watchtowers, and open flame pits.

faq.q: Why is Direforge Hill significant to the Wetlands?
aliases: what is happening at direforge hill
faq.answer: The hill is a hostile Dark Iron campsite in the northeastern Wetlands. Balgaras the Foul and his dwarves threaten travelers through the surrounding region.

Balgaras the Foul is a Dark Iron dwarf warlock who commands the forces encamped at Direforge Hill. His corrupted arts and aggressive presence in the hills make him a priority target for those defending the marsh.

angles.text: For the Bronzebeard dwarves of Ironforge, seeing the treachery of the Dark Iron clan creep into the Wetlands—especially under warlocks like Balgaras—is an outrage that must be answered with cold steel.
Druids passing through the Wetlands must contend with the hostile Dark Iron encampment on Direforge Hill.
